description: The embedding-pass door (T3's EmbedPending, surfaced as a trigger the app and the CLI call — the analogue of retrieval.reindex). It runs one scope's learnings through EmbedPending: every learning without a vector yet gets one, idempotently. Here three learnings in the project scope get a vector on the first run. A second run with nothing new embeds nothing (a zero is a real answer, not a silence); the no-route case is a refusal the daemon names (D5 — no route is the normal state), so a caller never reads 'nothing to embed' as 'embeddings failed'.
